shape_push_v1.description: Push v6: shared identity-blind geometric contact/heading/stroke selector with frozen SAM2 and supplied robot motion generation.
shape_push_v1.architecture_rationale: Two episodes and supplied motion planning favor a small joint categorical geometric decision rather than diffusion motor imitation. A 64-wide shared point encoder pools full-shape context; a 64-wide scorer shares local interactions. Only 18497 parameters train; SAM is frozen.

config.final_fit: Every final retained row from both episodes in initial sequential sweep, then activity-balanced sampling; no independent test withheld.

preprocessing.mask_model: Frozen SAM2.1-small, automatic interior points offline/grid online, neutral-table holes and causal hole references
preprocessing.metric_reconstruction: Weak sparse stereo top height; current visual shaft contact; differential robot prefix with validity masks
preprocessing.final_quality_filter: Every actor must match causal initial shape in metric area/residual/bidirectional support; details FINAL_QUALITY.md

data_plan.rationale: Retain original 12 buffered cuts and both full executor traces. Consider 1075 local state anchors at 15-row spacing plus original references, confined to source cuts. Actual final counts come from coverage.json. Every final supported channel from both episodes, including inspected development data, trains the delivered model. Complete traces remain context even when no valid contact target survives. Dense samples/retries are correlated, not independent shape experience.
data_plan.changes_from_prior: Original cut/prior and metadata copied verbatim to immutable original_source_plan.json and original_recording_metadata.json preparation reports. Sparse anchors are evidence references, not a whitelist. One-second local hindsight goals replace long witnesses; compact 96x3x3 candidates/stateless shape inputs replace larger raster/history proposal. True masked marginal likelihood retains partial contact supervision. SAM tensor resolved/pinned; semantic Qwen dependency allocated to supplied image-capable Agent with explicit ambiguity/inventory/layout responsibility. Stereo height remains a weak inferred training hypothesis, never board=table or commissioned metrology. First complete preparation yielded 341 rows; image review exposed merges and 24px absolute tool projection error. Point proposals, visible shaft localization, hole/area checks then yielded 311. Causal full-hole references recovered six inner-loop labels, but visual review still found partial bars such as A8310/A8370. FINAL_QUALITY.md documents the final general complete-actor gate applied to every row (no approved-index whitelist), exclusion/recovery accounting and online geometry_complete_validated requirement. Only post-filter rows train. Original ranges remain unchanged; fixed all-data final fit replaces episode early stopping because both episodes informed conversion; no independent test or robot execution is claimed.

dependencies: Public Meta SAM2.1-small tensor, Apache-2.0, SHA256 pinned; local installed SAM2/PyTorch/OpenCV/numpy/scipy. No runtime network. Supplied High-level Agent handles semantic identity/uprightness, injective inventory assignment, explicit layout and staging; its novelty competence is not measured here. Deployment needs commissioned camera/table/tool geometry, complete validated causal scene geometry, supplied planner/controllers and guards.
adaptations: All actual source data remains provenance/context; only supported contact channels enter final gradients. Current contact is image-localized rather than trusting erroneous absolute TCP projection. Causal shape references recover some holes and reject unresolved actor fragments; no future feature leakage. See FINAL_QUALITY.md and final preparation audits.
limitations: Two same-inventory recordings, approximate metrology and silhouette bias, residual perception/association/contact uncertainty, no force/success truth. Some cuts lose substantial supervision; rejected evidence is not asserted intrinsically useless. No unseen-shape/word or physical robot evaluation. New strings/goals do not establish physical novelty competence. Persistent complete scene validation, semantic ambiguity handling, commissioned full collision/guard binding and independent tests remain deployment prerequisites.
